thread:
nora: FYI our canary yesterday showed a subtle problem: automatic fallback flipped into a different degrade mode for a subset of requests and we couldn't tell why from dashboards. need better decision traceability.

mohit: saw that too. the fallback decision pipeline calls the cost-estimator (remote) + routing-policy service. either could time out and both currently surface the same 'fallback' metric.

ashley: oof. product needs to know whether a fallback was due to quota, cost, or model-compat. otherwise PMs can't prioritize fixes.

jake: proposal: enrich the fallback audit event with a discrete decision_trace_id + a short human-friendly reason chain. example: `decision_chain=["estimator:timeout(30ms)","policy:evaluate(pass)","final:fallback"]`.

mohit: also include a decision_latency_ms and a path enum {normal, degraded-grace, degraded-hard, shortcircuit}. that helps rollups.

nora: agree. we should add a console toggle on each rollout: "store last N decision traces" with N default 1000 and retention 7d. store only sample_request_ids + minimal context unless user opts-in for full trace. privacy/security caution.

sana: can we avoid storing raw prompts? must strip PII by default from traces. keep only metadata and decision reasons.

ashley: UX for console: on rollout details page show a compact "Decision Breakdown" bar with slices for reasons (quota, estimator-timeout, model-mismatch, runtime-error). clicking a slice opens example trace ids and a small replay link.

mohit: implementer notes: we should NOT add synchronous calls on the hot path. decision trace should be assembled asynchronously by correlating IDs. however we need a fast inline tag so the request can carry `decision_token` that maps to the async trace.

jake: for realtime ops we want an escape hatch: a per-rollout flag `explainability.live_sampling` that samples 0.1-5% of traffic and stores full traces to a secure queue for playback. default 0.1%.

ops-bot: feature-flag created: rollout.decision_trace_store with rollout scope. alert template `decision_trace_queue_backlog` added.

tim: alerting: add metric `decision.shortcircuit_rate` and `decision.mismatch_rate`. set initial Ops alert at 1% shortcircuit for 15m. also a slow-path alert if decision_latency_p95 > 50ms.

nora: for analytics, emit summarized counters per minute: `{reason, path, count, false_positive_estimate}`. false_positive_estimate derived from sampled replays (compare what would have happened if checks responded faster).

mohit: sampling guidance: `min(2000/day, max(0.001*requests, 1))` when live_sampling enabled, otherwise only store tokens. helps cost.

ashley: console affordance: allow operators to trigger a lightweight re-eval of a decision trace (replay the decision logic without running the model) and surface what would have happened if services responded in 5ms/20ms/100ms windows. helpful for tuning the deadline.

jake: we need a simple API endpoint to fetch traces: `/v1/internal/rollouts/{id}/decision_traces?limit=20&reason=estimator-timeout`. protect behind enterprise roles.

sana: security: redact prompt and upload sanitized payload to the replay queue. keep full raw trace only for customers with opt-in. log access audits.

ops-bot: rollout plan: feature-flag gated, canary 1% for 2h, monitor `decision_trace_store_errors` and `decision.shortcircuit_rate`. rollback window 30m.

tim: final ask from UX: add a small warning icon in the rollout list if `shortcircuit_rate > 0` and another for `explainability.live_sampling > 0` so folks know sampling is on. hover gives quick links to trace viewer.

nora: action items: 1) mohit + jake: implement token + async trace assembler + sampling queue 2) ashley: console cells + badges + re-eval button 3) sana: security + redact rules 4) tim: metrics + alerts 5) ops-bot: feature flag + rollout plan. let's sync EOD Friday.

mohit: starting a branch with the token header and async assembler. will stub the API surface and sample storage.

ashley: I'll mock up the UI cells and badges in figma and share a link.

sana: drafting redact patterns: strip emails, long sequences, file attachments, and replace with placeholders.

ops-bot: NOTE: monitoring alert `decision.shortcircuit_rate` created at 2026-03-21T11:05:00Z.

nora: thanks all. keeping this thread for the implementation notes. will open a short RFC with examples and a privacy checklist.
